snippet.title: Silver Pines - Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Silver Pines is a moody survival horror odyssey set in a small American town, and a new trailer during the Spring Showcase revealed more gameplay from this atmospheric adventure. It's coming to PC and consoles later this year.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2333000/Silver_Pines/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
